svg.title: The nonzero pure response implies V belongs to the image. If the whole output support is the line v, the map has rank one. Otherwise W has a nonzero positive block on v⊥, since it is the only response capable of supplying such a block. If some zi has a component on v⊥, the two cross directions Ci, C† i , modulo V , are independent; their opposite off-diagonal blocks distinguish them. Together with V and W they give at least four independent image directions. If no zi has such a component, the image is contained in span{V, W} and has rank at most two. Neither alternative has rank three.
